rationale: Resuming fermentation of glucose, lactate, and amino acids (arginine, arabinose) with ammonium. Nitrogen is limiting (12 mmol N available supports max 1.2 /h growth); carbon is in excess. Growth at 1.0 /h consumes 42 mmol C and 10 mmol N; remaining 49 mmol C is fermented to acetate, propionate, formate, and CO₂. Substrates are abundant and my transporters support all uptakes.
